schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 019 - Disabling Plugin Dependencies

questions.label: What happens when a user disables a plugin that other enabled plugins depend on?
questions.help: Recommended: block disabling until dependent plugins are manually disabled first. This mirrors the manual dependency-enable decision and prevents surprise cascading changes.
options: Block disabling until dependent plugins are manually disabled first
Allow disabling and mark dependents inactive/dependency-blocked
Show a confirmation listing dependents, then disable all together

questions.label: How should dependency-blocked plugins appear in Settings?
questions.help: Recommended: visible with disabled controls and a clear dependency-blocked reason.
options: Visible with disabled controls and dependency-blocked reason
Visible and editable, but not activatable

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify behavior for active panels, tool event subscriptions, and per-chat plugin instances when a dependency is disabled.
